assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The patient has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency coded I34.0.
The patient has a diagnosis of dizziness/giddiness coded R42.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
The balance on the claim is 837.42.
The denial was based on the required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to the service date.
The member retains the right to request a formal review of the determination within the timeframe specified in the member handbook.
The appeal requires submission of all supporting clinical documentation and a detailed letter of medical necessity to the appeals department.
